title: Debounce Memory search filtering
goal: Keep Memory search responsive with large stored-memory collections by avoiding a full content scan for every intermediate keystroke.
context: MemoryScreen.filteredMemories scans all stored records and runs localized case-insensitive matching on each search state update. Apply a short cancellable debounce before using the search query for filtering, while leaving memory changes and kind selection responsive.
forbidden_changes: Do not change memory persistence, deletion, retrieval, or record ordering.
Do not debounce memory kind selection or delay add/forget/clear actions.
Do not change Chat, Agent runtime, Orb, or startup handling.
Do not claim measured performance improvement without device measurements.
acceptance_criteria: Search filtering uses a separately applied query after a short cancellable debounce.
Rapid typing cancels prior pending debounce work.
Changing memory kind and updating stored memory records still updates the displayed results.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
Device-level performance is reported as unmeasured unless actual device evidence is collected.
verification: Review task cancellation and ensure filteredMemories reads only appliedSearch.
Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
dependencies: PR #473 lazy rendering of scrollable screens
recovery: Revert the single task commit if search results become stale or native build fails.
